name: OpenOS 1.4.1
description: Fixes OpenStore reporting "not enough RAM" or hanging at "Loading catalog" after the first transfer, and Control Center not opening from a swipe-down. mbedTLS now allocates every byte of a TLS session from a dedicated 52 KB arena instead of the general heap, so a handshake no longer depends on the heap offering one large block and certificate pinning succeeds even inside a running app. The Control Center runtime is allocated from the same arena. The catalog is spooled to the SD card during download, body transfers have an inactivity limit instead of waiting for ever, and the main task stack was trimmed from 32 KB to 20 KB (measured peak under 7.5 KB), returning 12 KB to applications.
